The hell's all this morning chatter about...?
I'm fuckin' tired...
Did you stay up all night with the computer?

Cuz that thing is amazing! The more I
research it, the more excited I get!

Ahhh, I bet it won't let me sleep tonight!
At this rate I might pull all my groin muscles!

<CLT=cltMIND>Is this the girls bathroom?
Okay. I was just checking.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
There's nothing on the screen.
<CLT=cltMIND>But just seeing it makes me feel sick...
